# Changelog

All notable changes to this plugin will be documented here.

## 1.0.1 — official logo

- Logo: replaced with the official red Todoist mark from https://todoist.com, rendered from the symbol SVG in the site header (`#DE483A` rounded tile, white checkmarks) at 192×192.

## 1.0.0 — initial release

- Added the `todoist` MCP server pointing at `https://ai.todoist.net/mcp`.
- Auth uses OAuth — no API key or client ID to configure.
- Logo: Todoist's official mark, from the `Doist` GitHub organization.
